0022600123.text: The Bucks (0-3) have lost three straight and sit 14th in the East and fifth in the Central, 2.5 games back, with an 0-1 mark at home. The Pacers (1-1) are third in the Central, one game back, and ninth in the East after a loss in their most recent game, and the teams have not met yet this season. Milwaukee won all four meetings in 2025-26, including a 134-123 victory in Milwaukee on March 15, 2026, and Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), while Ivica Zubac is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision.
